name: Monty's Doggy Daycare
short_description: Dog daycare on a farm estate in Amsterdam-Noord with outdoor play zones and transport service.
short_description_local: Hondendagopvang op een boerderij in Amsterdam-Noord met buitenruimtes en ophaaldienst.
description: Monty's Doggy Daycare operates an outdoor dog care facility on a farm estate in Amsterdam-Noord. Dogs are grouped by size and temperament into dedicated play areas equipped with sheltered resting spaces. The center provides daily trial visits, regular photo and video updates, and morning collection with afternoon drop-off across Amsterdam in custom-fitted vans.
description_local: Monty's Doggy Daycare verzorgt dagopvang voor honden op een boerderijterrein in Amsterdam-Noord. De honden worden op basis van grootte en energieniveau ingedeeld in aparte speelweides met overdekte rustruimtes. De opvang biedt proefdagen, regelmatige foto- en video-updates en een haal- en brengservice in Amsterdam met speciaal ingerichte bussen.

short_description: Cat hotel in Amsterdam offering private multi-level suites, daily playtime, and live camera access.

description: Cat Vibes Kattenhotel provides private cage-free accommodation for cats in Amsterdam. Each suite features multi-level climbing surfaces, private litter boxes, and continuous live camera access for owners. Services include daily group or private play sessions, specialized feeding routines, and regular photo updates.
